SELECT from_account_id::text AS hot FROM transfers GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT count(*)::int AS hot_rows FROM transfers WHERE from_account_id = '{{HOT}}'
SELECT count(*)::int AS transfers_total FROM transfers
SELECT now() AS at, relpages, relallvisible, autovacuum_count FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_stat_user_tables s ON s.relname = c.relname WHERE c.relname = 'transfers'
